ruledOut.name: <MemberRow>
ruledOut.why: List row geometry with a portrait in the leading cell — structurally identical to the inline-title row already declined.

ruledOut.name: <ActorPicker>
ruledOut.why: A pill trigger that opens the popover — which already counted it as one of its four callers.

ruledOut.name: <AddButton>
why: Dashed is a role on the button that owns the meaning.
"Sits in flow with its collection" is a usage rule, not a boundary.

ruledOut.name: <RailCard>
ruledOut.why: A composition that also smuggled back the 34px button size the set retires by name.

ruledOut.name: <FeatureCard>
ruledOut.why: Two ABSENT props on an identical shape is a props difference, not a distinction.

ruledOut.name: <BoundsInput>
ruledOut.why: "Two steppers with a rule between", by its own spec.

ruledOut.name: <CurrencyInput>
ruledOut.why: A composition, and wrong about the domain: it assumed a flat world-scoped coin ladder where the model defines a per-system acyclic denomination DAG.

ruledOut.name: <PremiumPanel>
why: A screen, not a primitive.
Its one original claim is copy — a product decision — and binding copy to a component makes the offer untranslatable against a codebase where every primitive takes pre-localized strings.
Canon also forbids any premium signal in the player window.

ruledOut.name: <Toast>
ruledOut.why: Foundry owns transient feedback and renders its own toasts over the module window regardless.

ruledOut.name: Destructive panel
ruledOut.why: Canon makes the dialog the default for manager confirmations; the arm is the carve-out.

ruledOut.name: <ValidationList>
ruledOut.why: The grouped row list is the same tab as the verdict, drawn by the one shipped surface, so a second name would point at no implementation of its own.

ruledOut.name: <AppRail>
ruledOut.why: The player window's icon rail and the manager's sidebar are one component with a variant: they share the item model and the active treatment, so `<AppRail>` is `<NavSidebar>`'s `icon` variant.

ruledOut.name: <BrowseCard>
ruledOut.why: The card grid is the same row model on one track, so a browse card is `<ListRow>` at `layout="card"`, and the grid around the cards owns their track.
